item.description: ⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show declines in internet connectivity across much of #Ukraine. The disruptions correspond to power outages amid a wave of deadly Russian drone and missile strikes this morning, described by witnesses as one of the most powerful such attacks in recent memory

media:content.media:description: Graph from NetBlocks showing network connectivity by region in Ukraine from November 19, 2026, to November 20, 2026. The y-axis represents normalized connectivity from 0% to 100%, and the x-axis represents dates and times. The graph indicates connectivity disruptions in multiple regions starting on the morning of November 20 (Ukraine time). The disruptions correspond to power outages following Russian missile and drone attacks targeting energy infrastructure. The chart has a dark background and includes the NetBlocks logo in the lower left corner with the Mapping Internet Freedom slogan, and connectivity lines for each region are color-coded.

item.description: ℹ️ Note: Apple services including the App Store and iCloud are experiencing international outages at the present time; incident not related to country-level internet restrictions or filtering #AppleDown #iCloudDown

media:content.media:description: Screenshot of Apple's System Status page on November 17, 2026, showing the operational status of Apple services in three columns. Green circles indicate available services, yellow diamonds indicate issues, and red triangles indicate outages. The App Store, Apple Music, and AppleCare on Device are marked as experiencing outages, while iCloud Account & Sign In is marked as experiencing an issue. Volume Purchase Program is listed as having a resolved outage. Most other Apple services, including iCloud Drive, iMessage, FaceTime, Apple Pay, Siri, and Apple TV, are marked as available. The page has a white background and was last updated at 6:22 PM UTC.

item.description: ⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show restrictions to Telegram on multiple internet providers in #Iraq and #Jordan; the measure comes amid heightened security concerns in both countries, with authorities citing the spread of extremist content, incitement and threats to national security.

media:content.media:description: Chart from NetBlocks showing platform feature restrictions by ISP in Iraq and Jordan from on November 16, 2026. The data indicates internet restrictions affecting streaming platform Telegram. Access issues are observed across major ISPs such as Asiacell, Zain and Orange with services down to 0%.

item.description: ⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a significant decline in internet connectivity in parts of occupied Crimea with high impact to Sevastopol, corresponding to power outages after Ukrainian drone attacks target energy infrastructure 🔌

media:content.media:description: Graph from NetBlocks showing network connectivity by region in Ukraine from October 29, 2026, to November 3, 2026. The y-axis represents normalized connectivity from 0% to 100%, and the x-axis represents dates and times. Two colour-coded lines represent connectivity in Sevastopol City and Crimea, remaining relatively stable at around 90–100% until November 2. On November 2, Sevastopol City experiences significant fluctuations, with connectivity repeatedly falling to around 35–50% before partially recovering. On the early morning of November 3, connectivity drops sharply again, reaching near zero in Sevastopol City and approximately 45% across Crimea, with limited recovery observed. The disruption corresponds to power outages following Ukrainian drone attacks targeting energy infrastructure. The chart has a dark background and includes the NetBlocks logo in the lower left corner with the Mapping Internet Freedom slogan. Sevastopol City (0% / 0%) and Crimea (43% / 47%)

item.description: ℹ️ Confirmed: A power outage has knocked out internet connectivity across much of La Palma, Canary Islands; the losses in service are attributed to severe storms and lightning, with near-total recovery now evident 🔌

media:content.media:description: Graph from NetBlocks showing network connectivity by region in Spain from October 23, 2026, to November 2, 2026. The y-axis represents normalized connectivity from 0% to 100%, and the x-axis represents dates. The graph indicates connectivity remaining stable in La Palma, Canary Islands throughout most of the period, before dropping on the early morning of November 2 (Spain time). The disruption corresponds to power outages due to swevere storms. Near-total recovery is now visible. The chart has a dark background and includes the NetBlocks logo in the lower left corner with the Mapping Internet Freedom slogan, and connectivity lines for each municipality are color-coded. Breña Alta (0% / 58%), El Paso (0% / 100%), Breña Baja (3% / 100%), Los Llanos de Aridane (13% / 89%) and Santa Cruz de La Palma (22% / 99%), respectively.

item.description: ⚠️ Confirmed: Russian social media network VK (VKontakte) is currently experiencing a major disruption, with metrics showing connectivity at 56% of ordinary levels. The incident comes amid reports of a Ukrainian drone attack in the vicinity of its St. Petersburg data center

media:content.media:description: Graph from NetBlocks showing network connectivity by provider in Russia from October 5, 2026, to October 18, 2026. The y-axis represents normalized connectivity from 0% to 100%, and the x-axis represents dates and times. A green line represents Russian social network LLC VK's (AS47541) connectivity remaining stable throughout most of the period, before dropping on the early morning of October 18 (Russia time). The disruption corresponds to a power outage following Ukranian drone attacks targeting datacenters.The minimum and current connectivity levels are shown as 56% and 56%, respectively. The chart has a dark background with a red circle highlighting the decline at the end of the period, and includes the NetBlocks logo in the lower left corner with the Mapping Internet Freedom slogan.

item.description: ⚠️ Confirmed: Live network data show a significant reduction in internet connectivity across the US territory of #Guam corresponding to power outages as Category 4-equivalent Super Typhoon #Champi passes the island; observed connectivity is now down to 41% of ordinary levels

media:content.media:description: Graph from NetBlocks showing network connectivity in Guam from October 9, 2026, to October 17 2026. The y-axis represents normalized connectivity from 0% to 100%, and the x-axis represents dates. A green line represents Guam's connectivity, remaining stable throughout most of the period, before dropping sharply on the evening of October 17 (UTC Time zone). The disruption corresponds to power outages due to the passing of Super Typhoon Champi. The minimum and current connectivity levels are shown as 41% and 41%, respectively. The chart has a dark background with a red circle highlighting the decline at the end of the period, and the NetBlocks logo in the lower left corner with the Mapping Internet Freedom slogan.
